notes: Where qa-tester/testing-apps save run evidence: a video per scenario (happy path, error handling, edge cases), and a folder per bug with its screenshot and video. Each run lands in <dir>/<ticket-or-session>/<YYYY-MM-DD>-<web|ios|android>/ with testing/{happy-path,error-handling,edge-cases}/ and bugs/<bug-n>-<slug>/. mode: "auto" (default) records and saves every run without asking; "ask" makes the delegating conversation ask the user before each run whether to record and save.
